messages.content: "請問您能否提供我過去5年微軟每季的歷史股息資料，然後再提供同樣的資料但是以年為單位？之後，能否幫我取得微軟過去60天和過去120天的股市資料？"

function.name: corporate_finance_dividend_data
function.description: Get historical dividend data of a specific company within a particular duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

company.description: The company that you want to get the dividend data for.

function.name: stock_market_data
function.description: Retrieve stock market data for a specific company and time frame. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

company.description: The company that you want to get the stock market data for.

message.reasoning:
The user wants:

1. Provide historical dividend data for Microsoft over the past 5 years on a quarterly basis.
2. Provide same data but aggregated yearly.
3. Then provide stock market data for Microsoft for the past 60 days and 120 days.

We need to use the functions. We have two functions: corporate_finance_dividend_data and stock_market_data.

We need to call corporate_finance_dividend_data twice: once with frequency="quarterly" and years=5; second with frequency="annual" and years=5.

Then call stock_market_data twice: once with days=60 and once with days=120.

We should do calls in order. The user wants all four pieces of data. We can call them sequentially. We'll produce calls to the function. The system will handle them. We'll output the calls. The user didn't ask for explanation, just the data. So we can call the functions. We'll produce calls in JSON format. We'll do them one after another. We'll produce separate calls. We'll not include any other text. We'll just call the functions.
